searchText: Kinda random question. What is the best secondary marketplace for ENS? ENS are ERC-721, so any popular NFT marketplace would work. Maybe opensea? That said, recently some ENS names I was looking at were squatted, secondary markets for ENS are honestly not a good thing. I was looking at opensea but wasn't sure if that was the best marketplace for a secondary sale https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KV5QlSgq7lg <@!273808422753796097> at 1 min
